key_insight: RS-MFBO combines sensitivity-based dimension reduction with multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization to efficiently search expensive, high-dimensional process models.
engineering_relevance: It helps engineers optimize industrial flowsheets with far fewer high-fidelity simulator runs, cutting computational cost while preserving solution quality.
method: Use Global Sensitivity Analysis to identify and retain the most influential design variables.
Fit a fidelity-augmented Gaussian process that links cheap approximations with expensive simulations.
Apply a cost-aware acquisition rule with cooldown and promotion to balance exploration across fidelities.
evidence_signal: The framework was tested on two industrial simulators—plasmid DNA bioprocess and green fuel synthesis—showing fewer high-fidelity evaluations while remaining competitive with single-fidelity baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of sensitivity screening and low-/high-fidelity correlation; weak surrogate fidelity alignment could reduce gains.
paper_title: Reduced-Space Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization of Process Simulation Models
